title: forsythia × densiflora
intro: Forsythia × densiflora, commonly known as Korean forsythia, is a hybrid plant species that results from the cross-breeding of Forsythia koreana and Forsythia viridissima. This plant is known for its bright yellow flowers and has been used in traditional medicine in East Asia for its health benefits. Forsythia × densiflora is believed to have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents present in Forsythia × densiflora include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and coumarins, which are thought to contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antimicrobial and antiviral activities.
